keywords: Embedded systems 2.Linux device driver programming 3.Embedded systemss programming 4.Raspberry Pi 5.Electronic circuits
educationalGoal: - Understand embedded systems from a broad perspective, and also specifically understand the technology of embedded systems, how embedded systems interrelate with industry, and the product trends of embedded systems. - Understand the technical knowledge and terminology related to embedded systems. - Understand Linux device driver development and utilize its design method to develop embedded systems. - Understand the skills required for embedded systems engineers.
advice: Learn about the technology of embedded systems being used as edge devices to support the IoT. Deepen understanding of embedded systems through lectures, training, and development exercises. [Embedded systems technology lectures] Listen to lectures by embedded systems engineers and learn about embedded systems from a broad perspective, and also specifically learn about the technology of embedded systems, how embedded systems interrelate with industry, and the product trends of embedded systems. [Embedded systems technology training] Systematically learn the basic technology of embedded systems. [Embedded systems development exercises] Learn practical techniques for building embedded systems through Linux device driver development exercises. No textbook is specified for this subject. Materials used in this class will be distributed.
requiredKnowledge: 1) Basic computer literacy (Windows and MS office, use of a text editor, etc.). 2) Understanding of the basic elements of C programming (conditional branching, iteration, functions, file I/O, pointers, etc.). Students should have taken “Introduction to IoT Programming” or have the equivalent knowledge. 3) Knowledge and experience with rudimentary Python programming and Linux programming is desirable.

activityGoals.body: To be able to explain embedded systems from a broad perspective and the technology of embedded systems.
To be able to explain the technical knowledge and terminology related to embedded systems.
To understand practical embedded systems design from a broad perspective and be able to build embedded systems.
To understand the skills required for embedded systems engineers and be able to identify your skill level.
